title.narrative: School infrastructure module integrated in the Ministry of Education's Information System, and made accessible to other relevant stakeholders

comment.narrative: Achieved. As a part of the Education Information Management System (EMIS) of the MoE, the School Infrastructure Module have been developed. This module aims to support the MoE in monitoring and prioritizing investments in school infrastructure. The module includes detailed information fields about key aspects of school infrastructure, such as structural elements, WASH, ICT, furniture, transportation, landscape, and intervention financing information, among others. This detailed information will inform the planning of investments in school infrastructure. The module is operational and handed over to the MoE.

title.narrative: Sets of medical waste management equipment operationalized and functioning through preparing and adopting a proper Infectious Control and Waste Management Plan (ICWMP)

comment.narrative: Achieved. The PIU reported that the 42 sets of medical waste management equipment, consisting of the microwave for sterilization of medical waste, plus a press destructor, have been installed in the designated locations. However, during monitoring visits in the field in the first semester of 2021, it was discovered that 2 sets of equipment were not connected to water and sewerage. Further monitoring was conducted to verify the operational status of all the equipment. MOH and the PIU had identified corrective actions for the twoospitals where the equipment was found not to be properly connected. PIU had submitted the official request letter to the MOH management, but the actions haven't been taken yet due to ongoing changes in the MOH management. The team recommended to PIU meet with new management and take an action on solving this issue.

title.narrative: School facilities with improvements in safety, resilience and functional conditions

comment.narrative: Currently, construction has been completed in six schools, and construction is underway in ten schools. At least four more contracts are planned to be signed by the end of the year. Six schools have been completed by the end of 2025, with 1 more will be completed by January 2026. To date, the consultant has received DD with a positive conclusion from the State Expertise for 20 schools. It is planned to complete seven DD packages by the end of 2025, with the remaining ones to be completed in early 2026. According to the work schedule, construction work on the last schools will begin latest in June 2026.
